48: func (s *SubjectAccessReviewer) AccessAllowed(serviceAccount string, sourceNamespace string, object runtime.Object) (bool, error) {
49: 	metaObject, err := meta.Accessor(object)
50: 	if err != nil {
51: 		return false, nil
52: 	}
53: 	// For convenience we still allow association between objects in a same namespace
54: 	if sourceNamespace == metaObject.GetNamespace() {
55: 		return true, nil
56: 	}
57: 
58: 	if len(serviceAccount) == 0 {
59: 		serviceAccount = "default"
60: 	}
61: 
62: 	allErrs := field.ErrorList{}
63: 	// This validation could be done in other places but it is important to be sure that it is done before any access review.
64: 	for _, msg := range validation.IsDNS1123Subdomain(serviceAccount) {
65: 		allErrs = append(allErrs, &field.Error{Type: field.ErrorTypeInvalid, Field: "serviceAccount", BadValue: serviceAccount, Detail: msg})
66: 	}

68: 		return false, allErrs.ToAggregate()
69: 	}

74: 	if err != nil {
75: 		return false, err
76: 	}

78: 		"Access review", "result", sar.Status,
79: 		"service_account", serviceAccount,
80: 		"source_namespace", sourceNamespace,
81: 		"remote_kind", object.GetObjectKind().GroupVersionKind().Kind,
82: 		"remote_namespace", metaObject.GetNamespace(),
83: 		"remote_name", metaObject.GetName(),
84: 	)
85: 	if sar.Status.Denied {
86: 		return false, nil
87: 	}
88: 	return sar.Status.Allowed, nil

106: // parsePodAddr parses the pod name and namespace from an address.
107: func parsePodAddr(addr string, clientSet *kubernetes.Clientset) (*types.NamespacedName, error) {
108: 	host, _, err := net.SplitHostPort(addr)
109: 	if err != nil {
110: 		return nil, err
111: 	}
112: 	if podIPv4Regex.MatchString(host) {
113: 		// we got an IP address
114: 		// try to map it to a pod name and namespace
115: 		return getPodWithIP(host, clientSet)
116: 	}
117: 	if podDNSRegex.MatchString(host) {
118: 		// retrieve pod name and namespace from addr
119: 		parts := strings.SplitN(host, ".", 4)
120: 		if len(parts) <= 1 {
121: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported pod address format: %s", host)
122: 		}
123: 		if len(parts) == 2 || parts[2] == syntheticDNSSegment {
124: 			// podname.ns[.pod] from service forwarder or direct call
125: 			return &types.NamespacedName{Namespace: parts[1], Name: parts[0]}, nil
126: 		}
127: 		// podname.subdomain.ns
128: 		return &types.NamespacedName{Namespace: parts[2], Name: parts[0]}, nil
129: 
130: 	}
131: 	return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported pod address format: %s", host)
132: }

167: // DialContext connects to the podForwarder address using the provided context.
168: func (f *PodForwarder) DialContext(ctx context.Context) (net.Conn, error) {
169: 	// wait until we're initialized or context is done
170: 	select {
171: 	case <-f.initChan:
172: 	case <-ctx.Done():
173: 	}
174: 
175: 	// context has an error, so we can give up, most likely exceeded our timeout
176: 	if ctx.Err() != nil {

182: 		return nil, f.viaErr

186: 	return f.dialerFunc(ctx, f.network, f.viaAddr)

191: 	log.Info("Running port-forwarder for", "addr", f.addr)
192: 	defer log.Info("No longer running port-forwarder for", "addr", f.addr)

40: // - perform any pod upgrade (left for rolling upgrade phase)
41: func HandleUpscaleAndSpecChanges(
42: 	ctx upscaleCtx,
43: 	actualStatefulSets sset.StatefulSetList,
44: 	expectedResources nodespec.ResourcesList,
45: ) (sset.StatefulSetList, error) {
46: 	// adjust expected replicas to control nodes creation and deletion
47: 	adjusted, err := adjustResources(ctx, actualStatefulSets, expectedResources)
48: 	if err != nil {
49: 		return nil, err
50: 	}
51: 	// reconcile all resources
52: 	for _, res := range adjusted {
53: 		if err := settings.ReconcileConfig(ctx.k8sClient, ctx.es, res.StatefulSet.Name, res.Config); err != nil {
54: 			return nil, err
55: 		}
56: 		if _, err := common.ReconcileService(ctx.parentCtx, ctx.k8sClient, &res.HeadlessService, &ctx.es); err != nil {
57: 			return nil, err
58: 		}
59: 		reconciled, err := sset.ReconcileStatefulSet(ctx.k8sClient, ctx.es, res.StatefulSet, ctx.expectations)
60: 		if err != nil {
61: 			return nil, err
62: 		}
63: 		// update actual with the reconciled ones for next steps to work with up-to-date information
64: 		actualStatefulSets = actualStatefulSets.WithStatefulSet(reconciled)
65: 	}
66: 	return actualStatefulSets, nil

70: 	ctx upscaleCtx,

73: ) (nodespec.ResourcesList, error) {
74: 	upscaleState := newUpscaleState(ctx, actualStatefulSets, expectedResources)
75: 	adjustedResources := make(nodespec.ResourcesList, 0, len(expectedResources))
76: 	for _, nodeSpecRes := range expectedResources {
77: 		adjusted, err := adjustStatefulSetReplicas(upscaleState, actualStatefulSets, *nodeSpecRes.StatefulSet.DeepCopy())
78: 		if err != nil {

80: 		}

82: 		adjustedResources = append(adjustedResources, nodeSpecRes)

103: // adjustStatefulSetReplicas updates the replicas count in expected according to
104: // what is allowed by the upscaleState, that may be mutated as a result.
105: func adjustStatefulSetReplicas(
106: 	upscaleState *upscaleState,
107: 	actualStatefulSets sset.StatefulSetList,
108: 	expected appsv1.StatefulSet,
109: ) (appsv1.StatefulSet, error) {
110: 	actual, alreadyExists := actualStatefulSets.GetByName(expected.Name)
111: 	expectedReplicas := sset.GetReplicas(expected)
112: 	actualReplicas := sset.GetReplicas(actual)

114: 	if actualReplicas < expectedReplicas {
115: 		return upscaleState.limitNodesCreation(actual, expected)

120: 		// We still want to update the sset spec to the newest one, but leave scaling down as it's done later.
121: 		nodespec.UpdateReplicas(&expected, actual.Spec.Replicas)
122: 	}
123: 
124: 	return expected, nil
125: }

128: func isReplicaIncrease(actual appsv1.StatefulSet, expected appsv1.StatefulSet) bool {

27: // SetupMinimumMasterNodesConfig modifies the ES config of the given resources to setup
28: // zen1 minimum master nodes.
29: // This function should not be called unless all the expectations are met.
30: func SetupMinimumMasterNodesConfig(
31: 	c k8s.Client,
32: 	es esv1.Elasticsearch,
33: 	nodeSpecResources nodespec.ResourcesList,
34: ) error {
35: 	// Check if we have at least one Zen1 compatible pod or StatefulSet in flight.
36: 	if zen1compatible, err := AtLeastOneNodeCompatibleWithZen1(
37: 		nodeSpecResources.StatefulSets(), c, es,
38: 	); !zen1compatible || err != nil {
39: 		return err
40: 	}
41: 
42: 	// There are 2 possible situations here:
43: 	// 1. The StatefulSet contains some masters: use the replicas to set m_m_n in the configuration file.
44: 	// 2. The StatefulSet does not contain any master but there are some existing Pods: we should NOT rely on the spec
45: 	//    of the StatefulSet since it might not reflect the situation, the node type "master" might just have been changed
46: 	//    and a rolling upgrade is maybe in progress.
47: 	//    In this case some masters are maybe still alive, decreasing m_m_n in the config could lead to a split brain
48: 	//    situation if the container (not the Pod) restarts.
49: 	masters := 0
50: 	for _, resource := range nodeSpecResources {
51: 		if label.IsMasterNodeSet(resource.StatefulSet) {
52: 			// First situation: just check for the replicas
53: 			masters += int(sset.GetReplicas(resource.StatefulSet))
54: 		} else {
55: 			// Second situation: not a sset of masters, but we check if there are some of them waiting for a rolling upgrade
56: 			actualPods, err := sset.GetActualPodsForStatefulSet(c, k8s.ExtractNamespacedName(&resource.StatefulSet))
57: 			if err != nil {
58: 				return err
59: 			}
60: 			actualMasters := len(label.FilterMasterNodePods(actualPods))
61: 			masters += actualMasters
62: 		}
63: 	}
64: 
65: 	quorum := settings.Quorum(masters)
66: 
67: 	for i := range nodeSpecResources {
68: 		// patch config with the expected minimum master nodes
69: 		if err := nodeSpecResources[i].Config.MergeWith(
70: 			common.MustNewSingleValue(
71: 				esv1.DiscoveryZenMinimumMasterNodes,
72: 				strconv.Itoa(quorum),
73: 			),
74: 		); err != nil {
75: 			return err
76: 		}
77: 	}
78: 	return nil
79: }
80: 
81: // UpdateMinimumMasterNodes calls the ES API to update the minimum_master_nodes setting if required,
82: // based on nodes currently running in the cluster.
83: // It returns true if this should be retried later (re-queued).
84: func UpdateMinimumMasterNodes(
85: 	ctx context.Context,
86: 	c k8s.Client,
87: 	es esv1.Elasticsearch,
88: 	esClient client.Client,
89: 	actualStatefulSets sset.StatefulSetList,
90: ) (bool, error) {
91: 	// Check if we have at least one Zen1 compatible pod or StatefulSet in flight.
92: 	if zen1compatible, err := AtLeastOneNodeCompatibleWithZen1(actualStatefulSets, c, es); !zen1compatible || err != nil {
93: 		return false, err
94: 	}
95: 
96: 	actualMasters, err := sset.GetActualMastersForCluster(c, es)
97: 	if err != nil {
98: 		return false, err
99: 	}
100: 
101: 	// Get current master nodes count
102: 	currentMasterCount := len(actualMasters)
103: 	currentAvailableMasterCount := 0
104: 	for _, p := range actualMasters {
105: 		if k8s.IsPodReady(p) {
106: 			currentAvailableMasterCount++
107: 		}
108: 	}
109: 	// Calculate minimum_master_nodes based on that.
110: 	minimumMasterNodes := settings.Quorum(currentMasterCount)
111: 
112: 	// Do not attempt to make an API call if there is not enough available masters
113: 	if currentAvailableMasterCount < minimumMasterNodes {
114: 		// This is expected to happen from time to time
115: 		log.V(1).Info("Not enough masters to update the API",
116: 			"namespace", es.Namespace,
117: 			"es_name", es.Name,
118: 			"current", currentAvailableMasterCount,
119: 			"minimum_master_nodes", minimumMasterNodes)
120: 		// We can't update the minimum master nodes right now, it is the case if a new master node is not created yet.
121: 		// In that case we need to requeue later.
122: 		return true, nil
123: 	}
124: 
125: 	return false, UpdateMinimumMasterNodesTo(ctx, es, esClient, minimumMasterNodes)
126: }

129: // to the given value, if the cluster is using zen1.

73: func ReconcileResource(params Params) error {
74: 	err := params.CheckNilValues()
75: 	if err != nil {
76: 		return err
77: 	}
78: 	metaObj, err := meta.Accessor(params.Expected)
79: 	if err != nil {
80: 		return err
81: 	}
82: 	namespace := metaObj.GetNamespace()
83: 	name := metaObj.GetName()
84: 	gvk, err := apiutil.GVKForObject(params.Expected, scheme.Scheme)
85: 	if err != nil {
86: 		return err
87: 	}
88: 	kind := gvk.Kind
89: 
90: 	if params.Owner != nil {
91: 		if err := controllerutil.SetControllerReference(params.Owner, metaObj, scheme.Scheme); err != nil {
92: 			return err
93: 		}
94: 	}

96: 	create := func() error {
97: 		log.Info("Creating resource", "kind", kind, "namespace", namespace, "name", name)
98: 		if params.PreCreate != nil {
99: 			if err := params.PreCreate(); err != nil {
100: 				return err
101: 			}
102: 
103: 		}
104: 
105: 		// Copy the content of params.Expected into params.Reconciled.
106: 		// Unfortunately it's not straightforward to change the value of an interface underlying pointer,
107: 		// so we need a small bit of reflection here.
108: 		// This will panic if params.Expected and params.Reconciled don't have the same underlying type.
109: 		expectedCopyValue := reflect.ValueOf(params.Expected.DeepCopyObject()).Elem()
110: 		reflect.ValueOf(params.Reconciled).Elem().Set(expectedCopyValue)
111: 		// Create the object, which modifies params.Reconciled in-place
112: 		err = params.Client.Create(params.Reconciled)
113: 		if err != nil {
114: 			return err
115: 		}
116: 		return nil
117: 	}
118:

121: 	if err != nil && apierrors.IsNotFound(err) {
122: 		return create()
123: 	} else if err != nil {
124: 		log.Error(err, fmt.Sprintf("Generic GET for %s %s/%s failed with error", kind, namespace, name))
125: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get %s %s/%s: %w", kind, namespace, name, err)
126: 	}
127: 
128: 	if params.NeedsRecreate != nil && params.NeedsRecreate() {
129: 		log.Info("Resource cannot be updated, hence will be deleted and then recreated", "kind", kind, "namespace", namespace, "name", name)
130: 		log.Info("Deleting resource", "kind", kind, "namespace", namespace, "name", name)
131: 		reconciledMeta, err := meta.Accessor(params.Reconciled)
132: 		if err != nil {
133: 			return err
134: 		}
135: 		// Using a precondition here to make sure we delete the version of the resource we intend to delete and
136: 		// to avoid accidentally deleting a resource already recreated for example
137: 		uidToDelete := reconciledMeta.GetUID()
138: 		resourceVersionToDelete := reconciledMeta.GetResourceVersion()
139: 		opt := client.Preconditions{
140: 			UID:             &uidToDelete,
141: 			ResourceVersion: &resourceVersionToDelete,
142: 		}
143: 
144: 		err = params.Client.Delete(params.Expected, opt)
145: 		if err != nil && !apierrors.IsNotFound(err) {
146: 			return fmt.Errorf("failed to delete %s %s/%s: %w", kind, namespace, name, err)
147: 		}
148: 		return create()
149: 	}
150: 
151: 	// Update if needed
152: 	if params.NeedsUpdate() {
153: 		log.Info("Updating resource", "kind", kind, "namespace", namespace, "name", name)
154: 		if params.PreUpdate != nil {
155: 			if err := params.PreUpdate(); err != nil {

- Updated root `go.mod`/`go.sum` for `k8s.io/api v0.18.4`.

- Refetched the latest pod before annotation updates to avoid stale fake-client updates.
- Fixed invalid `int` to `string` conversions in `hack/pipeline-validator`.

- `go test $(go list ./... | perl -ne 'print unless m{/test/e2e($|/)}')` passes.
